job.job_description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions that solve complex business challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
Develop and optimize LLM-based applications using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms.
Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using vector databases.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and monitor machine learning models.
Develop AI-powered chatbots, copilots, and intelligent automation solutions.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
Work with structured and unstructured data sources for model training and inference.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and developers to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and industry trends.

Required Skills

Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience with Machine Learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search, or ChromaDB.
Understanding of prompt engineering, RAG architecture, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience with REST APIs, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
Familiarity with data engineering concepts and SQL/NoSQL databases.
